description: Says whether a merchant's PCI DSS self-assessment questionnaire (SAQ) requires quarterly external scans by an Approved Scanning Vendor, under PCI DSS v4.0.1, and what to scan. Pass the SAQ type, or "unsure" to get every SAQ with who it is for.
name: do_i_need_an_asv_scan
title: Does this merchant need quarterly ASV scans?
